column1: # call_regress.expected.tsv - every known difference between the ORIGINAL binary (HEAD bcc134e)
# and the current tree, as found by tests/call_regress.sh. One row per difference, tab-separated.
#   status   approved: the user accepted the change. pending: known, not yet approved; it is printed
#            under PENDING USER APPROVAL and does not fail. Only the user moves a row to approved.
#   file     region | alleles | nodes (variant_nodes.tsv) | bimbam | cnrec | exit | crossing | inputs
#   kind     ADDED | REMOVED | CHANGED | EXIT | CROSSING | MULTICN | SAMPLES ...
#   id       matched against the original OR the current record id (bubble ids renumber under refine,
#            so the refined set has its own rows)
#   fields   CHANGED only: every changed field must match one of these, so approving a POS move does
#            not approve a GT change on the same record
#   (all of locus..fields take shell globs, or comma lists of them; '*' is any)
#   pin      the exact value: a comma list of the 12-hex-digit hashes of the complete difference
#            (every changed value, every haplotype) that this row accepts. A difference that matches
#            the row but not its pin fails, pending or approved, so approving 7 GT flips does not
#            this file back with the pins a run observed (a row whose pins changed comes back as
#            pending) and a pending TODO row per new difference: diff it, write the notes, keep it.
#   note     what the change is (optional column)
# Header-line (##) changes and pure ID renames are reported by the harness and never fail; they need
# no row here (a rename whose content also changed fails through its CHANGED item).

column10: note
